description: Use this when the user asks whether a draft invoice is ready to issue, what is missing for a valid UAE tax invoice, or why an invoice might not hold up as a tax invoice ("is INV draft ready to send?", "what's missing on this invoice?"). Checks one draft invoice, by invoice_id or invoice_number, for what would make it not a valid UAE tax invoice if issued now (VAT Executive Regulation Art. 59): supplier name, address and TRN; a VAT-registered buyer's name, address and TRN; the buyer TRN being the business's own; line descriptions; the exchange rate for a foreign currency; plus warnings (a full tax invoice with no buyer TRN) and e-invoicing notes. Each check has severity (block, warn, info), enforced (whether Fatura Go refuses the issue today), message, legal_ref and fix_url, the screen in Fatura Go where the user fixes it. invoice_type_at_issue is full, simplified or invoice (not VAT-registered on the date). Nothing is changed or issued; an issued invoice has nothing to check. Do not use it for what a tax invoice must show in general (tax_invoice_requirements) or for e-invoicing data fields only (check_einvoicing_readiness).

business_id.description: From list_businesses. May be left out: the invoice is then looked up in every business shared with this connection.
